plotTwists: {user} winds up for the yeet... and {target} was already gone, having left three seconds earlier for unrelated reasons.
{target} braces for impact but instead gets gently, almost tenderly, set down. {user} chickened out at the last second.
The yeet somehow triggers a chain reaction — everyone nearby starts yeeting each other.
A chicken wanders into the flight path and gets yeeted instead, entirely unbothered. 🐔
{user} yeets {target}, but they land perfectly in a nearby chair, completely unfazed, like it was planned.
Lightning strikes nearby at the exact moment of launch, for dramatic effect. ⚡
The Whisper Merchant appears mid-yeet and tries to sell {target} 'landing insurance.'
